description: This Java class 'ICalConverter' handles conversion between internal work effort representations and iCalendar format. It uses the ical4j library to generate and parse iCalendar data, managing properties, components, alarms, and synchronization with work effort data in a database. The class provides methods for creating iCalendar representations from work efforts, updating work efforts from calendars, and managing party assignments and recurrence rules.

classes.name: ICalConverter
classes.description: A class for converting work efforts to and from iCalendar format, utilizing the ical4j library for parsing and generating iCalendar data, including managing reminders, attendees, organizers, and recurrence rules.

methods.name: getICalendar
methods.description: Generates an iCalendar string for a specific work effort ID if it is published and the user has permission.

methods.name: storeCalendar
methods.description: Processes an incoming iCalendar input stream to update or create related work efforts and associated data.

methods.name: storePartyAssignments
methods.description: Stores party (participant) assignments extracted from a calendar component into the work effort context, creating or updating assignments as needed.
